title: Flood Fill replaces all tiles to the left

posts.author: AveyondFan
posts.body:
So, I've recently encountered an issue where, while mapping, when I use the fill tool, the fill tool will fill all tiles on the row to the left of where I click.
It's easier to show via a gif, so here:
I apologize for the quality, but it does still illustrate my point well enough.
I want to know why this bug occurs and if/how I can fix it. I
do not
want a suggestion of switching to another RPG maker. I refuse partake in planned obsolescence.

posts.author: TeiRaven
posts.body: That's a new one on me. Does it happen when you flood fill other places on the map as well, or just that particular row?

posts.author: AveyondFan
posts.body:
TeiRaven said:
That's a new one on me. Does it happen when you flood fill other places on the map as well, or just that particular row?
Click to expand...
It appears to happen when either A: I attempt to flood fill a row of like items, or B: when I attempt to use the flood fill on a single tile.
It does NOT happen with irregularly shaped areas or vertical lines as far as I know. I’ll need to do more testing once I can get back onto the maker.
I also tested it in other projects; same bug happens, so it’s not this specific project that’s the issue.

posts.author: TeiRaven
posts.body:
Did you set your transparent background color to ultramarine, or did it decide that itself on install? A few weeks ago, we were discussing how XP sometimes installs with a random, bright transparency color (instead of a soft pale blue,which is the regular color) and
Andar said it's because of the difference between old and new Windows registries
. It's possible that flood fill glitch has the same root? But that's a shot in the dark and I don't have any idea how to fix it, because I know the random color background persisted when reinstalled (a different color each time, even).
If you got XP on Steam, you can probably still try verifying the files like ShadowDragon suggests. You can also try reinstalling; though as mentioned, the bright backgrounds are persistent so this may be as well. Otherwise, this is way out of my fix-it realm
Did you install in any kind of compatibility mode?

posts.author: TeiRaven
posts.body:
Very possibly, although I think I may have seen someone get it on Win10 a year or two ago. I also have never had these problems myself on my Win10 machines.
The fact that it happens with VXA, which is almost as old, does suggest that it's a problem related to the new operating system with the old software. Try compatibility mode--you may need to run the installer in compatibility mode. I don't know exactly how to do that on 11, but you should be able to look it up.
